tools.title: Visual Logger
tools.summary: Time-based debugging tool that records gameplay events, text, locations, shapes and actor state.
why: Reconstructs what happened before a bug
workflow: Inspect the timeline and spatial snapshots.
Convert recurring manual diagnosis into automated assertions where possible.
tools.codex: Codex can add targeted logging instrumentation and reason from exported logs/screenshots.
tools.caution: Log only meaningful state; excessive logging makes sessions hard to read.

tools.title: Gameplay Debugger
tools.summary: In-game overlay/debug categories for AI, navigation, behavior and custom gameplay state.
why: Faster than opening many editor panels
workflow: Add project-specific categories for complex systems.
tools.codex: Codex can add custom debugger categories for systems it builds so future debugging is easier.
tools.caution: Developer-only instrumentation should not become shipping runtime overhead.

tools.title: Unreal Insights
tools.summary: Unreal's trace analysis suite for CPU, frame timing, tasks, loading and subsystem performance.
tools.codex: Provide trace findings to Codex so it optimizes measured hotspots instead of guessing.
tools.caution: Do not optimize from anecdotes; profile representative builds and scenarios.

tools.title: Memory Insights
tools.summary: Allocation/lifetime analysis inside Unreal Insights for memory leaks, growth and expensive allocation patterns.
workflow: Capture memory traces in the problematic scenario.
tools.codex: Codex can analyze summarized allocation hotspots and adjust ownership/loading logic.
tools.caution: Memory traces can be large; capture focused sessions.

tools.title: Networking Insights
tools.summary: Detailed network traffic profiling inside Unreal Insights.
tools.codex: Use as evidence when Codex refactors replicated Blueprints/C++.
tools.caution: Always profile realistic player counts and network conditions.

tools.title: Stat Commands & Console Profiling
tools.summary: Fast first-pass profiling using stat unit, stat game, stat gpu and related console diagnostics.
why: Guides when to open deeper Insights/GPU tools
workflow: Move to Unreal Insights/GPU profiling for deep diagnosis.
tools.codex: Codex can include performance console-command checklists in feature verification.
tools.caution: Stats are snapshots/aggregates; use trace tools for deep causal analysis.

tools.title: Blueprint Debugger
tools.summary: Pauses Blueprint execution in PIE/SIE with breakpoints, watches, call stacks and step controls.
why: Inspect runtime pin and variable values
Step through visual execution instead of guessing
See breakpoints, watches and execution trace in one place
Debug a specific Blueprint instance in PIE
workflow: Select the Blueprint instance in Debug Object.
Place a breakpoint on the suspicious node.
Run PIE/SIE and reproduce the issue.
Inspect watches/pins and step through execution.
Fix the graph, compile, and reproduce again.
tools.codex: Codex should use MCP-readable state/logging when available, while this remains the human runtime truth tool for complex visual execution bugs.
tools.caution: Pin values are only meaningful after the relevant nodes have executed.
